output.summary: Riverside's slowdown is a local staffing failure. After the saute/pasta cook left in August and the vacancy went unfilled, that station accounts for 71% of the rise, and group operations deferred the GM's transfer requests. The rest of the group's roughly 17.6-minute ticket time is the board-approved result of the 2024 Made Here menu, which coincided with rising satisfaction, so the group-wide inefficiency, satisfaction-erosion and spreading-staffing hypotheses are contradicted. Restore Riverside's line position now. Do not standardize on frozen components: the trial lowered food quality, and Pellston's benchmark excludes scratch kitchens. Do not replace the GM or tie bonuses to ticket time until the reason for the departure is confirmed.
